images.label: SMASH · current reconstruction
images.credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/SMASH/D. Nidever; image processing: Travis Rector, Mahdi Zamani & Davide de Martin

wcsSource.description: ICRS TAN AVM fields extracted from the pinned publisher TIFF; original reference dimensions retained.

images.registrationNote: Current cloud color source. Full 6737 × 6536 image; about 9.35° × 9.07°. Publisher sky coordinates anchor the relative image comparison. The shared saved user-authored model fit (scale 3, +39°, translated about the SMASH pivot) is applied for the Alignment display; it does not establish scientific size or simulated-to-observed star identities. Covers only part of the full simulated stellar field.

images.label: ESO VISTA · infrared, star-aligned

wcsSource.description: Sky anchor is SMASH publisher AVM. Exact native-pixel homography is verified against discrete matched star fields, with held-out residuals and negative controls in source/vista-direction-gate.json. Original VISTA WCS is retained as provenance but not used for geometry.

images.registrationNote: 8954 × 10000 ESO Y/J/Ks image; about 7.7° × 8.6°. Image-to-image scale, rotation and handedness fitted to 16,020 SMASH stars; 5,340 held out, P90 error 0.67 SMASH pixels (~3.3 arcsec), matched hull 83%. Corrected the publisher placement; corners outside the matched hull are extrapolated. The same saved user-authored model fit as SMASH is then applied for display, not as scientific size or simulation registration. Infrared display colors; still partial density coverage. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial; the current 3D reconstruction is unchanged.

images.label: NASA WISE · 24° infrared candidate

wcsSource.description: Exact ICRS TAN WCS from matching CDS HiPS2FITS; JPEG/FITS raster orientation verified. NASA/IPAC data, CDS W4/W2/W1 display-color composition.

images.registrationNote: 24° NASA/IPAC WISE field rendered by CDS as W4/W2/W1 RGB, 6000 × 6000 (~14.6 arcsec/pixel). Fixed publisher WCS verified against 34,811 independently retrieved AllWISE W1 catalogue positions; 11,604 reserved checks, P90 0.632 native WISE pixels, 99.3% matched hull. No geometry correction fitted. This checks position, not diffuse photometry or visible atlas seams. The shared user-authored SMASH model fit is applied separately for display. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial.

images.label: DSS2 · 24° wide optical
images.credit: Digitized Sky Survey - STScI/NASA, Colored & Healpixed by CDS

wcsSource.description: Exact ICRS TAN WCS from the matching CDS HiPS2FITS color FITS; JPEG/FITS orientation verified. See source/dss2-wide-receipt.json.

images.registrationNote: Survey WCS placement across a 24° field. Photographic plate seams, foreground stars and uneven backgrounds remain; use for coverage comparison before reconstruction. This is not calibrated diffuse emission. The same saved image-to-density visual fit is applied as for SMASH. Import and alignment preview only; cloud processing awaits explicit approval.

images.label: Horálek · optical wide field
images.credit: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/P. Horálek (Institute of Physics in Opava)
images.registrationNote: Measured registration to SMASH using 592 unique point sources; 198 held out of final fit, median 0.59 SMASH pixels and P90 1.12 pixels (4.996 arcsec/pixel). Homography is an approximation; validated point hull covers 60.2% of source raster, outer area extrapolated. No per-pixel distances or simulation correspondence implied. The same saved image-to-density visual fit is applied as for SMASH. Import and alignment preview only; cloud processing awaits explicit approval. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial; compact residual and diffuse light remain inspectable before a new volume bake.

wcsSource.description: Registered to discrete stars in the pinned full-size SMASH image, whose publisher ICRS TAN AVM supplies the sky anchor. Exact correspondences, held-out residuals and source hull recorded in registration receipt.

images.label: SMASH DR2 · wider optical mosaic
images.credit: SMASH survey / D. Nidever et al.; CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA
images.license: Public survey distribution; retain institutional and paper credit. Image-specific license not declared; see source/smash-mosaic-acquisition.json.

wcsSource.description: SMASH publisher AVM is the sky anchor. 20,661 matched point identities; 6,887 held out; P90 1.82 native reference pixels. Central 30% matched hull, outer field extrapolated. See source/smash-mosaic-registration.json.

images.registrationNote: 4111 × 5000 optical mosaic from the SMASH survey team. Wider irregular field footprint; black regions are missing observations, not zero light. 20,661 star matches to current SMASH; 6,887 held out, P90 1.82 SMASH pixels (~9.1 arcsec). Central 30% verified; outer placement extrapolated. Shared saved image-to-density visual fit applied. Visible exposure/field seams retained. Catalogue preview only; no cloud processing.

wcsSource.description: Star registration to the pinned original SMASH image, whose publisher AVM supplies the sky anchor. See source/ciel-austral-registration.json.

images.registrationNote: 14,400 × 14,200 author original; 8192-pixel inspection preview. RHaVBO: optical RGB enhanced with emission-line data, from the APOD-featured Ciel Austral project; this is its optical color variant. 4,418 matched SMASH stars; 1,473 held out, P90 2.02 SMASH pixels, 74.1% matched hull; remaining outer area extrapolated. Shared saved image-to-density visual fit applied, not a physical simulation registration. Detailed central field, not full stellar outskirts. Comparison candidate only; no cloud processing.

images.registrationNote: 3,074 × 3,163 author-hosted 0.25× preview; the advertised 160 MP AstroBin version was unavailable. Author page labels RGB, while the retained footer mentions dual narrowband; colors are a processed optical composite. 4,861 matched SMASH stars; 1,621 held out, P90 0.66 SMASH pixels; 73.9% matched hull, outer area extrapolated.
